gaps.title: Messages through places outside the release
gaps.note: Parametric, not measured. A share v of the traffic is visible; messages are scaled by 1/v; pairs run from the observed pairs (every unseen message repeats one) to one new pair per unseen message. The first message moves earlier by (1/v - 1) times the early spacing of visible messages (0.5 h), not before the first dated record. Other signs are left as counted, so this is a floor on the shift. Source of v: assumed.
